notes: MERGED 2026-07-23: live engine file combined with a crawler+verifier reap of marshall.ucsd.edu (data/requirements/colleges/marshall.json). Verified verbatim: Natural Science = one course EACH in Biology/Chemistry/Physics (flat 3-of-63 bucket replaced by three one-each buckets), and Disciplinary Breadth = four 4-unit courses OUTSIDE the major, two upper-division, one of the upper-division from the annually reissued Significant Writing list; DB courses may never overlap the major, and lower-division major courses cannot overlap lower-division breadth GE. Disciplinary Breadth is NOT auto-checkable (any-department, outside-major) so it is carried as prose here and on the DOC bucket note, not as a bucket. A Public Service option (AIP 197P; TMC 120; PAL EDS 130-146 + EDS 139; Global TIES ENG 100D+100L) can fill one upper-division DB slot. ELWR folded into the DOC note (must be satisfied before DOC 2/3). AH&I fixed to needed=1 with the approved course list (satisfiable instead by AP US History / HS certification). DEI unioned with the campus-wide list; JTCCER added (Fall 2024+ first-years; transfers exempt). Transfers with full IGETC/Cal-GETC or UC Reciprocity clear all lower-division GE and owe only two upper-division DB courses (one Significant Writing). Also required university-wide but not bucketed: 180 total units, 60 upper-division units, 35-of-last-45 senior residency, 2.0 GPA, major declared by 90 units. No foreign language requirement at Marshall.

buckets.label: Dimensions of Culture (DOC)
buckets.note: Take in order for a letter grade: DOC 1 Reading Diversity (4u, Fall), DOC 2 Arguing Justice (6u, Winter), DOC 3 Imagination (6u, Spring); D or higher to advance; completing the sequence satisfies the UC Writing Requirement. ELWR must be satisfied before DOC 2/3 (AWP coursework if placed). IGETC transfers and juniors/seniors from other colleges take DOC 100D instead (also satisfies DEI). ALSO REQUIRED (not auto-checked): Disciplinary Breadth - four 4-unit courses outside the major, two upper-division, one of those from the Significant Writing list; no overlap with major courses; transfers with full IGETC/UC reciprocity owe only the two upper-division (one writing).

buckets.label: Natural Science — Biology
buckets.note: One Biology course from Marshall's approved list. Verified verbatim rule: three Natural Science courses total, one EACH in Biology, Chemistry, and Physics. Major overlap permitted/encouraged. AP/IB applies only per the official university AP/IB charts.

buckets.label: Natural Science — Chemistry
buckets.note: One Chemistry course from Marshall's approved list (part of the one-each Bio/Chem/Physics Natural Science rule). Major overlap permitted.

buckets.label: Natural Science — Physics
buckets.note: One Physics course from Marshall's approved list (ASTR/ESYS/PHYS/SIO offerings; part of the one-each Bio/Chem/Physics Natural Science rule). Major overlap permitted.

buckets.label: Mathematics, Statistics and Logic
buckets.note: Two courses via one of three options - A: two Math/Advanced Stats (BIEB 100, MATH 3C-181A); B: one Math/Advanced Stats + one Intro Stats (COGS 14A, HDS 60, POLI 30/30D, PSYC 60, SOCI 60) or Programming/Logic (BILD 62, COGS 18, CSE 6R/8A/11, CSS 1, LIGN 17, MAE 5, PHIL 10/12); C: one Intro Stats + one Programming/Logic. Two Intro Stats or two Programming alone do NOT satisfy. Major overlap permitted.

buckets.label: Humanities and Cultural Studies
buckets.note: Two courses from the curated approved list (domestic and global cultures), not whole departments. List merges the current Marshall site list (AAS/ETHN incl. R-variants/HILD/LATI/LTEN/RELI/GSS) with the prior approved-list PDF (TWS 21-26, LTCS 52). Several courses double-count for DEI and/or AH&I (e.g. HILD 7A-C). Approved major-overlap courses exist.

buckets.label: Fine Arts
buckets.note: One nonperformance course from the approved list: Music (MUS 4-19, 20, 80 - MUS 80 must be taken for 4 units), Theatre & Dance (TDGE 1/5/10/11/12, TDHT 21/22/23), or Visual Arts (VIS 1/2/3/20/21A-C/22/84). MUS 4-19 range expanded per the site's notation. Approved major-overlap courses exist (e.g. MUS 4-14 for Music majors).

buckets.label: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
buckets.note: University-wide: ONE approved four-unit DEI course, grade C-/P or better; may double-count with major, minor, college GE, or elective. DOC 100D satisfies DEI for IGETC transfers and juniors/seniors from other colleges. The official Senate list changes every quarter - this merged list is representative, not exhaustive; verify against the current list at senate.ucsd.edu / undergrad.ucsd.edu. The enumerated list is the Academic Senate's campuswide approved list (dei-list-of-courses.pdf, updated December 2025), identical for every college; /R and GS codes are the remote and Global Seminar versions of the same approved course.

buckets.label: American History and Institutions (AH&I)
buckets.note: University requirement: ONE approved course (grade P or C- or better) - OR commonly satisfied without coursework via AP US History (score 3+), IB, or high-school certification (C+ in one unit of US history, or half-unit US history + half-unit civics/American government); CA high-school graduates typically satisfy it automatically. If already satisfied by exam/HS record, no course is needed despite needed=1 here. Additionally, ANY upper-division HIUS course (HIUS 100-199, except colloquia) satisfies AH&I - not enumerable as exact codes, so not auto-checked.

buckets.label: Jane Teranes Climate Change Education Requirement (JTCCER)
buckets.note: University-wide: first-year students entering Fall 2024 or later complete one approved course with grade C- or P or better. Transfer students are exempt. Approved list maintained by the Academic Senate (senate.ucsd.edu); list shown here mirrors the campus-wide list and may grow.
